_note: Two-plane decomposition for GH #1584 — GenUI B3, the judged pack-idiom eval (PRD-G6 · SPEC-N3 · PRD §8 m3). OUTSIDE-IN nodes = the subsystems the eval touches (a NEW sibling data dir `a2ui/corpus-genui/` — NOT inside `a2ui/corpus/`, whose A2UI gates walk every .jsonl/.json there; a pure core under `src/corpus-genui/`; a Node shell under `tools/corpus-genui/`; the rubric doc; the site page; the standing deterministic gate). INSIDE-OUT actions = what the eval must DO, split hard along the key boundary: keyless legs (collect · apply · report · the standing gate · the rubric + its calibration over committed fixtures) vs key-bearing legs (generate · judge), whose CODE ships stub-tested tonight but whose EXECUTION is Kim's named manual run. plan:true — every leaf carries a checkable accept. The LLD is `.claude/docs/lld/genui-b3-judged-eval.lld.md`; component ids LLD-C1..C7 map 1:1 onto the non-leaf nodes n1..n7.

nodes.label: LLD-C1 — pure core: record model + verdicts model (src/corpus-genui/)
record.ts — GenuiCorpusRecord + validateGenuiRecord (tier-1 = the wire's own structural gate via readGenuiLine/GENUI_MAX_HTML_BYTES + sha-256 htmlHash/packHash recompute + pins) + the E_* code enum
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` — validateGenuiRecord returns [] on a well-formed record; returns E_SCHEMA (missing name/promptText/html/meta pins), E_WIRE (html > GENUI_MAX_HTML_BYTES or empty surfaceId — the SAME constant genui-line.ts exports, not a copy), E_HASH (stored htmlHash/packHash ≠ fresh recomputation), E_SCORE_ORPHAN (meta.qualityScore present while status≠judged); pure — a self-grep proves no `node:` import under src/corpus-genui/

nodes.label: verdicts.ts — GenuiVerdictsFile parse (rubric:'genui-pack-idiom', rubricVersion must equal the caller-supplied marker, judgedBy, date, model?, verdicts{name→{qualityScore,passed,failingDimensions?,dimensions?,rationale?}}) + mergeVerdictArchive (latest date wins; same-date disagreement = conflict)
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` — parseGenuiVerdictsFile batches every issue (bad JSON · rubric≠'genui-pack-idiom' · rubricVersion≠expected · unknown key · non-1..5 score · passed≠(qualityScore≥4)); mergeGenuiVerdictArchive picks the latest date, returns conflicts on same-date disagreement, treats same-date identical as idempotent

nodes.label: lint.ts — the deterministic D4 evidence floor: externalRefs (script/link/img src outside the sandbox allow-list), tokenRefs (--md-sys-* occurrences), scriptBlocks, byteLength — recorded on the record, cited by the judge, never a score
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` — lintGenuiHtml over three fixtures returns the exact counts (a pack-anatomy snippet: externalRefs 0 / tokenRefs ≥1; an off-idiom fixture with a CDN <script src>: externalRefs 1); pure string scanning, no DOM

nodes.label: LLD-C2 — the data dir a2ui/corpus-genui/ (prompts.json · records/v1/<pack>.jsonl · verdicts/ · fixtures/ · index.json · README.md)
prompts.json — the committed prompt matrix v1: 4 prompts per pack × 3 packs (+ the pack-less control arm reusing the same prompts), each a realistic user ask that never names the pack or its idioms
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` (the standing gate, n6a) — prompts.json parses; promptSetVersion=1; every packId ∈ GENUI_PACKS ids; every promptText non-empty and free of the pack's id/label tokens (grep-asserted); ids unique

nodes.label: fixtures/ — two labeled calibration fixtures (a pack's own anatomy snippet wrapped as a document; an off-idiom counter-fixture loading a CDN library) — NEVER records, never scored into the shard
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` — both fixture files exist, validate as bare genui envelopes, the standing gate asserts they are NOT present under records/ and no verdict file names them

nodes.label: verdicts/ + records/ start EMPTY (README.md is the only content) — the no-fabrication law; index.json is the derived empty summary
nodes.accept: `git ls-files packages/agent-ui/a2ui/corpus-genui` shows prompts.json, fixtures/*, README.md, index.json and NO *.jsonl / verdicts/*.json; index.json = `report` leg's byte-identical regeneration with zero records (runs:0, m3:null)

nodes.label: LLD-C3 — the rubric .claude/docs/rubrics/genui-pack-idiom.md v1.0 (D1 envelope validity · D2 pack-idiom use · D3 prompt fit · D4 sandbox-reality conformance; all [gate]; qualityScore=MIN; passed=≥4 — PRD §8 m3's bar)
the rubric document with `version: 1.0` marker, four typed dimensions with 1/3/5 anchors + evidence column, aggregation + top-failure, runtime-role preamble (read verbatim by the judge leg)
nodes.accept: `python3 <docs plugin>/skills/make-rubric/scripts/harness_checks.py rubric .claude/docs/rubrics/genui-pack-idiom.md` exits 0; the file carries a `^version:\s*1\.0$` line the tool's readRubricVersion() matches

nodes.label: calibration record — two independent fresh-context reads of BOTH committed fixtures (n2b), Δ ≤ 1 per dimension; the anatomy fixture lands ≥4, the counter-fixture lands ≤2 on D2 and D4
nodes.accept: the rubric's Calibration section carries the two-column table per fixture with every Δ ≤ 1 and the two outcomes opposite (passed true / false); authored keyless by the build seat's two reads, labeled as fixture calibration — not a judged run

nodes.label: LLD-C4 — the Node shell tools/corpus-genui/ (eval-genui-corpus.ts CLI + fs.ts + legs) — the ONE writer of corpus-genui/

CLI entry + leg dispatch + exit codes (0 green · 1 red, each listed · 2 setup/no-key) + --dry-run + the .env/process.env key reader (run-flagship precedent) + resolvePair model validation against providers.json
nodes.accept: `npm run eval:genui-corpus -- --help` exits 0 and lists collect|generate|judge|apply|report with the KEYLESS/NEEDS-KEY tag per leg; `npm run eval:genui-corpus -- generate` with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env or .env exits 2 with the named no-key message and writes nothing (asserted by the tools test via a child process); an unknown --model exits 2 naming resolvePair's reason

nodes.label: collect leg (KEYLESS) — materializes pending records from already-captured genui envelopes (--from <dir|file> of {genui:{surfaceId,html}} lines or DevtoolsEvent/recordTurn transcripts) under provenance source:'captured'; with no input, validates the dir + prints the prompt matrix and exits 0
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` — collect over a fixture capture dir writes N pending records (status:'pending', no qualityScore, htmlHash/packHash filled, lint filled), exact-dup by htmlHash reported E_DUP and skipped, re-run is a byte-identical no-op; collect with nothing to collect exits 0 and writes nothing

nodes.label: generate leg (NEEDS KEY) — per prompt×pack (+ --control pack-less arm): produce() with genuiSurface {enabled, sourceBody: pack.body, exclusive:true, dogfood:false}, the SAME ProduceDeps shape the dev proxy builds (anthropicProvider + retrieve over the A2UI shard + defaultCatalog), captures the ONE genui line, writes a pending record with source:'generated' + model/packHash/promptSetVersion/generatedAt pins; a turn with no genui line is recorded as a miss (E_NO_GENUI), never a fabricated record
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` — with a STUB AgentProvider injected (the produce-loop.test.ts precedent) yielding a canned genui line, the leg writes exactly the expected record shape per (prompt,pack); a stub yielding only A2UI/prose lines yields E_NO_GENUI in the run report and no record; exit 1 iff any miss; the real anthropicProvider path is reached only through the key-bearing CLI arm (never in a test)

nodes.label: judge leg (NEEDS KEY) — per pending record: system = the rubric doc VERBATIM + a fixed JSON-verdict wrapper constant; user = the pack body + promptText + the html + the lint evidence; one stream call via the SAME AgentProvider seam; strict JSON parse → a GenuiVerdictsFile written to --out (default corpus-genui/verdicts/<date>--<slug>.json, never overwriting); a malformed reply is E_JUDGE_PARSE for that name — NO verdict written for it
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` — with a stub provider returning a canned verdict JSON the leg writes a VerdictsFile that parseGenuiVerdictsFile accepts (rubricVersion = the marker read from the rubric doc); a stub returning prose yields E_JUDGE_PARSE, the file omits that name, exit 1; --calibrate runs each record twice and reports per-dimension Δ; an existing target path with different bytes halts before any write (both hashes named)

nodes.label: apply leg (KEYLESS) — validates a VerdictsFile against the marker, requires every named record to exist and be pending (or carry the IDENTICAL verdict — idempotent), writes qualityScore/passed/failingDimensions/verdictDate onto the records (status:'judged') and archives the file verbatim under verdicts/ in the same all-or-nothing step (the ADR-0165 pattern); unknown name or conflicting re-verdict halts the whole run before any write
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` — apply over a pending fixture shard + a verdicts fixture rewrites exactly the named records and archives the file; a verdict naming an unknown record halts with nothing written; re-applying the same file is a byte-identical no-op; a DIFFERENT verdict for an already-judged name halts naming both

nodes.label: report leg (KEYLESS) — derives index.json (rubricVersion · promptSetVersion · per-pack rows {name, promptId, packId, model, status, qualityScore, passed, failingDimensions, htmlHash, verdictDate} · aggregate m3 {judged, passed, passRate, minScore, meanScore, perPack, control?}) + a summary.md to stdout; --require-m3 exits 1 when the floor (every judged pack-conditioned record ≥ 4 — the PRD §8 m3 reading) is unmet
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` — report over the empty dir yields index.json with records:0 and m3:null; over a judged fixture set yields the exact aggregate; output is sorted + stable (two runs byte-identical); --require-m3 exit code follows the floor

nodes.label: LLD-C5 — the docs page site/genui-corpus.html + pages/genui-corpus.ts (section GenUI, L2 manifest row, sitemap regenerated)

the page: imports corpus-genui/index.json (summary) + records/v1/*.jsonl?raw (html); renders the m3 panel (rubric version, prompt-set version, judged/passed/passRate/min/mean per pack, control delta when present), one row per record with its verdict, and each JUDGED record's html through a REAL ui-sandbox-frame behind a disclosure (lazy — frames mount on open)
nodes.accept: `npm test genui-corpus` (jsdom) — with the committed empty index the page renders the honest empty state naming `npm run eval:genui-corpus` and NO score cells; with an injected fixture index/shard it renders one row per record with the verdict values and mounts a ui-sandbox-frame whose .html equals the record's html on disclosure open; `npm run test:browser:site` — the fixture row paints a frame (the pixel-truth leg)

nodes.label: site-manifest.json L2 row (GenUI section) + `node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs` regeneration
nodes.accept: `npm test sitemap` — G1 byte-identity holds after regeneration; G2 resolves ./genui-corpus.html to ≥1 sitemap entry

nodes.label: LLD-C6 — the standing deterministic gate src/corpus-genui/corpus-genui-data.test.ts (runs in npm test; keyless by construction)

the gate: every record line parses + validateGenuiRecord=[] + hashes recompute; every verdicts/*.json parses against the CURRENT rubric marker and names only existing records; every record carrying a qualityScore has an archived verdict with IDENTICAL values (the no-fabrication leg); index.json is byte-identical to a fresh derivation; prompts.json rules (n2a); fixtures never in records (n2b); a self-grep proves no live-model/key reference in any test
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` green on the committed (empty) dir AND red when a planted record carries a score with no archived verdict (the negative control, asserted inside the test over a temp copy) ; `npm run check` green (check:tools covers tools/corpus-genui/)

nodes.label: LLD-C7 — wiring + records: package.json `eval:genui-corpus` script (NOT in check/test/test:browser), vitest.config.ts tools include line for tools/corpus-genui/*.test.ts (the serial integration edit), corpus-genui/README.md + the LLD's realized-state note, roadmap §3/§4 reconciliation (done by the planner), site-manifest (n5b)

package.json script `eval:genui-corpus` → `node --experimental-strip-types packages/agent-ui/a2ui/tools/corpus-genui/eval-genui-corpus.ts` (the rescore.ts run path); grep-asserted absent from check/test/test:browser
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui` — a test reads package.json and asserts the script exists and that `check`, `test`, `test:browser` (and their sub-scripts) never reference eval-genui-corpus (SPEC-N3 / live-agent SPEC-R3)

nodes.label: vitest.config.ts `tools` project include gains 'packages/agent-ui/a2ui/tools/corpus-genui/*.test.ts' (explicit line, never a wildcard — the GH #112 rule)
nodes.accept: `npm test corpus-genui-tools` runs ≥1 test (a probe that fails if the include line is missing: count asserted by the tools test file's own existence + `vitest run --project tools` listing it)

nodes.label: corpus-genui/README.md — the operator runbook: the key boundary, the five legs in order, the named manual run Kim executes, what is never hand-authored
nodes.accept: README names every leg with its KEYLESS/NEEDS-KEY tag, the exact `npm run eval:genui-corpus -- <leg>` invocations, and the no-fabrication rule; `npm test corpus-genui` asserts README.md is the only non-data file at the dir root

actions.label: represent one GenUI output as a pinned, hash-identified record (pack + prompt + model + html) that validates deterministically without a model
reject a structurally invalid or oversize envelope at tier 1 using the wire's own gate, never a second copy of it
carry deterministic sandbox-reality evidence (external refs, token use) the judge cites instead of re-deriving
fix the prompt matrix so m3 measures pack conditioning, not prompt leakage
provide calibration fixtures that are visibly not corpus records
start with zero records and zero verdicts — never a fabricated or stubbed score in the tree
define the pack-idiom standard with a version marker, typed anchored dimensions, MIN aggregation and the ≥4 bar (m3)
prove the standard is readable consistently (two reads within ±1) before any judged run
run any leg from one exit-coded entry with the key boundary explicit per leg and fail-fast with no key
turn already-captured GenUI envelopes into pending records without a model
generate fresh pack-conditioned GenUI outputs through the real producer path with a live model, recording misses honestly
score pending records against the rubric with a live model into a verdicts file, refusing to write an unparseable verdict
apply a verdicts file to records all-or-nothing and archive it verbatim, idempotently
derive the m3 figure and a stable summary the docs page reads
present corpus + verdicts on the site, honest when empty, rendering judged html through the real containment host
make the page discoverable (manifest + sitemap) under the site's own gates
keep the committed data self-consistent on every npm test and red any score without a matching archived verdict
expose the named manual run as an npm script that no standing gate ever invokes
arm the tool tests under vitest's explicit tools include list
tell the operator exactly what to run, in what order, and which steps need a key
